div.div: بَنُو أَرْفَدَةَ , (S, K,) or أَرْفِدَة, which latter is the more common and more approved, (TA,) mentioned in a trad., (S,) A class of the Abyssinians, (S, K,) who danced: (S:) or a surname of them: or they were so called from the name of their chief ancestor, (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
